CN: DSH 托盘助手 — DeepSeek Harness 的 WPF 托盘扩展：一键配置 Node.js"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"/npm/dsh 环境，托盘启停 Web UI。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-desktop-tray — DSH Tray Helper"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A WPF (.NET Framework 4.6.2) desktop tray assistant for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`). It lives in the tr"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ay and solves the usability pain of environment setup and Web UI start/stop — **no more manual termi"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"nal windows, no more memorizing URLs**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Project page: hope-phenom.github.io/dsh-desktop-tray
> Repository: github.com/Hope-Phenom/dsh-desk"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"t page: hope-phenom.github.io/dsh-desktop-tray
> Repository: github.com/Hope-Phenom/dsh-desktop-tray"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Environment check & one-click fix (Environment tab)"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Item | Capability |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Node.js | Auto-detects version (PATH + common install locations); one-click install when missing: "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"`winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS` first, falling back to the official MSI (latest LTS fetched live)"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"; PATH refreshed automatically after install |
| npm mirror | Shows the current registry; can specif"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"y a mirror **per-command for npm operations issued by this tool** (`--registry`, your global config "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"is untouched); optional "write global npmrc" (only affects the global config after explicit confirma"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"tion) |
| dsh | Local version vs. latest remote version (built-in semver comparison); one-click inst"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"all/update (`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest`, explicit `@latest` avoids custom `tag` config "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"traps); tray balloon when an update is available |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> The whole health check is time-bounded (~2 min) with step-by-step progress; unreachable-network it"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ems degrade gracefully (e.g. "remote version query failed") — **the UI never freezes**."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### DSH service start/stop (Service tab / tray menu)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Configurable port (1-65535) or random port (`--port 0`, OS-assigned), launched hidden in the backg"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"round
- Parses the real URL from dsh output (accurate for random ports too); opens the browser autom"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"atically once the service is ready (health probe passes) (can be disabled)
- **The browser handoff i"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"s owned by this tool**: newer dsh (≥ `0.1.0-rc.8`) opens a tab on its own, so the tool appends `--no"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"-open` — **checked = exactly one tab, unchecked = none at all**. Older dsh (< `0.1.0-rc.8`) gets no "},{"id":"p12s6","text":"such flag and behaves exactly as before
- **Port-in-use preflight** + **external dsh instance scan**"},{"id":"p12s7","text":" before start: prevents two instances from corrupting sessions by writing the same `DSH_HOME` concur"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"rently
- Stop = kill process tree (`taskkill /T /F`); unexpected exits are detected, notified, and s"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"tate is reset
- Full runtime log panel (stdout/stderr streamed live for diagnostics)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Tray"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Menu: Start / Stop / Restart DSH, Open Web UI, Copy URL, Environment Check, Main Window, Auto-star"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"t at logon, Exit
- **Exit = stops the DSH service first**, so no orphaned node processes are left be"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"hind
- Running-state icon shows a green badge; closing the main window hides to tray; single-instanc"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"e (launching again activates the existing window)
- Double-click the tray icon opens the main window"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" by default; you can change it to open the Web UI in Settings"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Notification enhancements (Notification Enhancements tab)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Notifies on every dsh `turn/end` (each response round)
- Optionally also notifies for subagents/su"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"btasks
- Shows tray notifications and/or runs a user-defined external command (e.g. an existing Pyth"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"on notification script)
- One-click install/update/uninstall of the bundled `dsh-notify-hook` plugin"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"
- Notification payload includes `sessionId`, `parentSessionId`, `turn`, `reason`, and `durationMs`"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> Notifications are only emitted when dsh is launched through dsh-desktop-tray (it injects `DSH_NOTI"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" are only emitted when dsh is launched through dsh-desktop-tray (it injects `DSH_NOTIFY_ENABLED=1`)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Other"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Lightweight**: built with native WPF for Windows only; fast startup, low memory footprint, and n"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"o heavy runtime
- **Bilingual UI (中文 / English)**: auto-detects the system language at startup — no "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"configuration needed; switch anytime from the Settings page, **takes effect immediately and is saved"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" automatically**
- Auto-start uses the **HKCU registry Run key, no admin rights required** (current "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"user only)
- Optional auto-start of the DSH service when the tray app launches
- **Clean up dsh envi"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ronment** (Settings page): stop dsh → uninstall the global npm package → rename the data directory ("},{"id":"p19s7","text":"API credentials & sessions) to `.dsh.bak-<date>` as a **backup, not a delete** (recoverable) → remov"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"e the logon auto-start entry; full log streaming, cancellable; **Node.js is NOT uninstalled**
- Sett"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"ings persisted to `%APPDATA%\DshNotifyicon\settings.json` (atomic write; corrupt files are backed up"},{"id":"p19s10","text":" and defaults restored)
- All background operations (npm/winget/install) run async and stream to the"},{"id":"p19s11","text":" UI without blocking it"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- Windows 10 / 11 (.NET Framework 4.6.2 ships with the OS — no extra runtime install)
- Node.js ≥ 18"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" (**one-click installable from the tool**, Environment tab)
- dsh: `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" (**one-click installable/updatable from the tool**)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Building"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Requires Visual Studio (with the .NET Framework 4.6.2 targeting pack) or a command line with MSBuild"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"equires Visual Studio (with the .NET Framework 4.6.2 targeting pack) or a command line with MSBuild."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- Stop is a force kill (`taskkill /T /F`): dsh persists sessions roughly every ~5s, so at most ~5s o"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"f trailing conversation may be lost (not a graceful shutdown)
- The mirror applies only to npm comma"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"nds issued by this tool by default; "Write Global npmrc" permanently affects all npm operations of t"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"hat user (confirmed in the UI)
- If the tool itself is force-killed from Task Manager, dsh may be le"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ft behind: the external-instance scan detects it on next start and prompts for handling
- `--host` o"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"nly supports `127.0.0.1` (a dsh limitation; the tool does not expose this option)
- Debug and Releas"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"e builds share the single-instance mutex and cannot run at the same time
- The black transparent ico"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"n has low contrast on dark Windows taskbars (the running-state green dot still shows status)
- The U"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"I language switch takes effect immediately and is saved; tray balloon buttons are localized by Windo"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"ws itself (the content follows the UI language)"}],"truncated":true}
